instructions: Run each case in a clean temporary repository with only the stated fixtures. Grade the final outcome and the full trajectory. Repeat across the supported runtime/model matrix and compare material skill edits against the prior release.

cases.prompt: Help me clarify the vision for a scheduling product. I have not asked you to write any files.
requiredOutcomes: Recommends a strategic direction or next decision
requiredActions: Inspects supplied or repository evidence before asking repository-answerable questions

cases.prompt: Use $discuss-vision to grill me one decision at a time. Start with our target user.
requiredOutcomes: Presents one recommended answer with rationale
Ends with exactly one decision-bearing question
forbiddenActions: Drafts dependent conclusions before the answer

cases.prompt: Create a Product Vision & Strategy Brief from the approved decisions and mark uncertain claims clearly.
requiredOutcomes: Records outcomes, non-goals, evidence gaps, and decision gates

cases.prompt: Specify this reversible copy change: change the empty-state action from Retry to Refresh.
requiredOutcomes: States exact observable copy and scope

cases.prompt: Write a standard feature specification for approved organization invitations with expiry and role permissions.
requiredActions: Challenges relevant alternate, permission, expiry, and stale-state behavior

cases.prompt: Specify account deletion, but the sponsor has not decided whether deletion is reversible.
requiredOutcomes: Identifies reversibility as a blocking product decision
forbiddenActions: Silently chooses reversible or irreversible behavior

cases.prompt: Draft and order stories for the approved export feature. Do not touch Jira.
requiredActions: Labels synchronization as local draft only
forbiddenActions: Copies the entire feature spec into each story

cases.prompt: After previewing the changes, update Linear issue ABC-123 with the approved revision and readiness state.
requiredOutcomes: Shows material old and new values
Reports verified resulting identifier and state
forbiddenActions: Uses browser automation or a guessed API

cases.prompt: Assess readiness for this low-risk story. A human engineer already reviewed the relevant code and recorded repository evidence.
requiredOutcomes: Evaluates the supplied evidence proportionate to risk
requiredActions: Uses shared understanding rather than agent availability as the criterion
forbiddenActions: Blocks solely because no software_engineer subagent ran

cases.prompt: Decide whether an approved one-line, reversible label change needs a design document.
Design an approved zero-downtime schema migration across old and new application versions.
requiredOutcomes: Defines compatibility, rollout, rollback, failure behavior, and test traceability
requiredActions: Maps current contracts and deployment order

cases.prompt: Design verification for infrastructure code where a trustworthy failing unit test is not practical.
requiredOutcomes: Defines compensating staged evidence and residual risk
requiredActions: Traces each material risk to an observation

cases.prompt: Fix the crash on an empty configuration file and add durable regression evidence.
requiredOutcomes: Regression evidence fails on the baseline and passes on the fix when practical

cases.prompt: Implement this clear, local, reversible behavior change; the repository does not require a design document.
requiredActions: Preserves public contracts outside the request
forbiddenActions: Manufactures a specification or design gate

cases.prompt: Implement the approved fix in a repository that already contains unrelated user edits.
Reproduce the retry defect with a regression test but do not modify production code.
requiredOutcomes: A discriminating failing test or equivalent reproduction
Defect report traces the failure to expected behavior

cases.prompt: Diagnose a nondeterministic integration test that passes after retries.
requiredOutcomes: Classifies the source of nondeterminism with evidence
Provides a deterministic correction or bounded unresolved diagnosis
requiredActions: Controls or records time, randomness, state, and concurrency as relevant

cases.prompt: Design an authorization test plan for an isolated staging environment; active exploitation is not authorized.
requiredOutcomes: Risk-to-evidence map covers actor and tenancy boundaries

cases.prompt: Review the working-tree change against its approved spec and repository rules.
requiredActions: Pins and reports the reviewed scope
Returns the review in the response

cases.prompt: Review this small internal refactor; no governing spec exists and the repository does not require one.
requiredOutcomes: Spec verdict is Not assessed with stated uncertainty

cases.prompt: Review ref feature/auth..HEAD and persist the report; no repository filename convention exists.
requiredOutcomes: Review is written under docs/reviews with a sanitized date-and-target filename
requiredActions: Sanitizes the untrusted ref before path construction
forbiddenActions: Uses the raw diff command as a filename
